$comment: Generated by orchestrator/backend/scripts/generate_agent_schemas.py from app.api.assessment.ProbeRunRecordRequest plus agent-side overlays where the CLI contract is intentionally stricter than the backend model.

request_variant_id.title: Request Variant Id
request_variant_id.description: ID of the request variant this probe targeted. Ties the probe to a specific endpoint definition.

service_id.title: Service Id
service_id.description: ID of the service under test. Omit when request_variant_id is provided (service is inferred).

coverage_item_id.title: Coverage Item Id
coverage_item_id.description: ID of the coverage item this probe fulfills. Links probe runs to the coverage tracking table.

auth_context.title: Auth Context
auth_context.description: Authentication state used during the probe (e.g. 'anonymous', 'user', 'admin', or a credential slug).

input_slot.title: Input Slot
input_slot.description: Attack surface class where the payload was injected (e.g. 'query-param', 'json-body', 'http-header', 'path-segment', 'cookie').

payload_value.title: Payload Value
payload_value.description: Exact payload string sent in the probe. Include URL-encoding if relevant.

tool_name.title: Tool Name
tool_name.description: Tool or script that sent the probe (e.g. 'sqlmap', 'ffuf', 'burp', 'custom-script'). Required.

agent_name.title: Agent Name
agent_name.description: Agent that dispatched this probe (e.g. 'vulnerability-analyst'). Defaults to empty when tool ran directly.

result_status.title: Result Status
result_status.description: Outcome: 'signal' = anomaly detected, warrants escalation to a finding. 'tested' = ran cleanly, no anomaly. 'no-signal' = explicit negative result. 'attempted' = sent but outcome unclear. 'blocked' = WAF/control stopped probe. 'error' = tool or network failure.

observed_http_status.title: Observed Http Status
observed_http_status.description: HTTP response status code received (e.g. 200, 403, 500). Null for non-HTTP probes.

signal_type.title: Signal Type
signal_type.description: What anomaly was detected when result_status is 'signal' (e.g. 'time-delay', 'error-disclosure', 'different-response-length').

evidence_ref.title: Evidence Ref
evidence_ref.description: Path or ID of the artifact capturing the probe exchange (e.g. 'scans/ffuf-run1.json').

notes.title: Notes
notes.description: Freeform observations about this probe run (anomalies, tool warnings, raw output excerpts).

target_host.title: Target Host
target_host.description: Hostname or IP of the probed target (e.g. 'api.example.com', '10.0.1.5').

target_path.title: Target Path
target_path.description: URL path probed (e.g. '/api/v1/search'). Include query string only if it was fixed across all payloads.

target_port.title: Target Port
target_port.description: TCP port probed. Omit when port is implied by the scheme (80/443).

title: Assessment Probe Run
